extracted.stage: Pre-application; IHT computation not yet finalised
extracted.summary: A solicitor acting for executors of an estate of about £586,000 is asking for lending criteria and indicative pricing ahead of borrowing against estate property to pay inheritance tax and fees.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry about funding for the administration of this estate. To take this further we would need the amount the executors expect to borrow once the IHT computation is available, confirmation of the jurisdiction in which the estate is being administered, and details of the estate assets including the property to be charged. It would also help to know whether a grant of probate has been obtained and whether any IHT payment deadline applies. We will send our general criteria for your review, and a colleague will follow up once we have the above information. Nothing in this message should be taken as an offer of funding or an indication of terms.
